text: This isn't just theory — it's everything ahead of you. Every app on your phone, every website, every game is a program: a set of instructions that someone wrote. In this course, you'll write those instructions in a language called C. And no matter how advanced the topic gets later — repeating steps, making decisions, handling data — you'll always be doing the exact thing you learned today: breaking a problem into precise, ordered steps a computer can follow. Master this way of thinking now, and the rest of C becomes learning new kinds of instructions, not a new way of thinking.
